global_caption: The video consists of 9 shots and is a short realistic-style makeup tutorial with a warm tone throughout. The setting is a clean, bright home vanity area, primarily lit with natural light from the window combined with soft fill lighting. The entire video features clear Chinese The emotional tone remains calm, confident, and professional.
shot1: Shot 1 opens with a fade-in, using a medium close-up eye-level shot. The subject is seated in front of a vanity mirror, with slightly blurred makeup brushes and skincare bottles in the foreground. The focus is on her clear, bare face and its reflection in the mirror. The background features warm-toned home decor and desk organization, with soft lighting spreading from the side-front, revealing natural skin texture. She gently raises her hand to indicate her facial condition, then points to the products on the table, clearly mouthing “今天做一个清透通勤妆，保留自然感”. The camera slowly pushes in, establishing the tutorial's goal and initial state.
shot2: Shot 2 follows with a hard cut from the previous shot, transitioning to a close-up overhead view with a slight first-person perspective, creating a continuous composition from the tabletop to the face. Focus initially lands on her fingers unscrewing the cap of a moisturizer, then follows to her cheeks and forehead. Skincare products on the table form leading lines, with shallow depth of field emphasizing the texture of lotion and primer. She presses the moisturizer into her palm and gently spreads it across her face, then dots primer onto her cheeks, forehead, and chin, narrating in Chinese “先保湿，再薄上一层隔离让后续更服帖”. The The camera slightly tilts down and pans to follow her hand.
shot3: Shot 3 enters with a hard cut matching the action, shifting to a close-up facial detail, using a near-eye-level shot. A sponge is held in the foreground, while the mirror background is softly blurred. Focus tightly follows the foundation application from the bridge of the nose to the cheeks. Under consistent warm lighting, foundation is dotted onto the face and evenly patted out with the sponge in rhythmic motions. Localized skin tone gradually unifies, surface becomes smoother while retaining natural texture. The camera gently pushes in and slightly pans right to emphasize the transition from partial to full-face coverage.
shot4: Shot 4 cuts hard from the previous shot, transitioning to a tighter close-up of the under-eye and nostril area, framed in a slight high-angle close-up composition. The center of the frame focuses on the alternating motion between the concealer brush and fingertip, while the background softens into warm, blurred color blocks. She precisely dabs concealer onto the inner corners of the dark circles and both sides of the nostrils, then gently blends it using a small brush and fingertip. The dullness gradually brightens and the redness softens visibly. The camera remains nearly static, with only a minimal push-in to emphasize fine details.
shot5: Shot 5 transitions via a hard cut into eyebrow tutorial, using a medium close-up at a slightly angled eye-level view. The mirror image and real person form a dual-layer composition, focus locked on the eyebrow shape and the eyebrow pencil in hand.
shot6: It begins with a close-up overhead view capturing the eyeshadow palette and brush picking up pigment, then smoothly transitions to a frontal close-up of the eyes. She blends light brown shadow into the crease, applies a deeper shade at the outer corner, carefully lines along the base of the lashes, and finally curls her lashes. The eye's definition becomes progressively more vivid, with lashes lifting into a graceful curve. The camera initially moves forward slightly, pauses briefly, then subtly tilts upward following the curling motion, enhancing the sense of sequential progression.
shot7: Shot 7 transitions from the previous shot with a soft dissolve into cheek enhancement, using a medium close-up eye-level shot. Composition balances both cheeks symmetrically, with a highlighter palette below forming a secondary guide. In the same soft warm light, she lightly sweeps blush on the outer apples of the cheeks, then uses a small brush to add highlight to the bridge of the nose and cheekbones. Her complexion visibly becomes softer and more radiant, with controlled natural glow on the skin surface.
shot8: Shot 8 cuts sharply from the previous shot into a close-up of the lips, using an eye-level extreme close-up. Background maintains consistent warm tone and shallow depth of field. The camera slightly pushes in, then stabilizes gently, highlighting the final step before completion.
shot9: Shot 9 concludes with a soft dissolve from the previous shot, using a medium shot at eye-level with a slight mirror-facing composition. On the left, either a small inset of her original bare face or a head turn creates a before-and-after comparison; on the right, the completed makeup is shown directly. Focus is on the overall clear, unified finish and facial expression change. Background remains the same vanity area, warm lighting stable, avoiding stylistic jumps. The soft The camera first slightly pulls back to establish the full view, then gently pushes back to freeze-frame on the before-and-after contrast, forming a complete narrative loop.
